questions.q: Let ${a}_{n}, n \ge 1,$ be an arithmetic progression with first term 2 and common difference $4.$ Let ${M}_{n}$ be the average of the first $n$ terms. Then the sum $\mathop{∑}_{n = 1}^{10}{M}_{n}$ is
questions.solution:
& The sum of first $n, n \ge 1$ terms of arithmetic progression with first term 2 and common difference $4,$ is
${S}_{n} = \dfrac{n}{2} [ 4 + ( n - 1 ) 4 ] = 2n^{2}$
So, the average of the first $n$ terms

${M}_{n} = \dfrac{Sn}{n} = 2n$

$\text{Now,}\mathop{∑}_{n = 1}^{10}{M}_{n} = 2\mathop{∑}_{n = 1}^{10}n$

$= 2 \times \left(\dfrac{10 \times 11}{2}\right) = 110$

&=1+\frac{6}{n+1}
\end{aligned}$
